title: Nvidia and SK Group Announce $500 Billion-Plus AI Data Centers Initiative
description: Nvidia and SK Group have announced a $500 billion-plus initiative for AI data centers and a memory partnership.

sources.title: Nvidia, SK Group unveil $500 billion-plus AI data centers initiative, memory partnership
Nvidia locks down memory supply from SK Hynix as part of $500 billion AI deal
Samsung, SK Hynix to Ink Large Chip Supply Deals With US Firms

sections.heading: AI Data Centers Initiative
paragraphs: According to Reuters, Nvidia and SK Group have unveiled a $500 billion-plus AI data centers initiative. This initiative aims to develop advanced AI data centers.

sections.heading: Memory Partnership
paragraphs: CNBC reports that Nvidia has locked down memory supply from SK Hynix as part of the $500 billion AI deal. This partnership ensures a stable supply of memory for Nvidia's AI projects.

sections.heading: Large Chip Supply Deals
paragraphs: Bloomberg.com states that Samsung and SK Hynix are set to ink large chip supply deals with US firms. These deals are expected to boost the chip supply chain between South Korea and the US.

faq.q: What is the $500 billion-plus initiative about?
faq.a: The $500 billion-plus initiative by Nvidia and SK Group is focused on developing advanced AI data centers, according to Reuters.

faq.q: What is the memory partnership between Nvidia and SK Hynix?
faq.a: Nvidia has secured a memory supply from SK Hynix as part of the $500 billion AI deal, ensuring a stable supply of memory for Nvidia's AI projects, as reported by CNBC.
